caption: A large, orange plastic egg is rolled up a plastic slide, then rolls down, ending at the bottom.
action: letting something roll up a slanted surface so it rolls back down
first_prompt: A single realistic photograph of the initial scene immediately BEFORE the following action begins: A large, orange plastic egg is rolled up a plastic slide, then rolls down, ending at the bottom. Show the participants and objects in their starting positions, with enough room for the action. Show one moment only, not a montage, not the completed outcome. No text or diagrams.

clauses.text: The orange egg must be positioned at the base of the plastic slide for the rolling motion to begin.
The egg must roll upward along the curved surface of the slide, showing continuous motion.
The egg must reach the top of the slide and then roll back down the same path.
The egg must come to rest at the bottom of the slide, maintaining its position after the motion ends.
